name: Admin Authentication & Dashboard Access
expected: Authenticates admin credentials and accesses admin overview dashboard

name: Dashboard KPI Accuracy
expected: Calculates and displays real platform KPIs: Registered Users, Total Listings, Marketplace Orders, Platform Revenue
actual: Platform KPI cards rendered authoritatively from backend database

name: Admin Product Listing
expected: Lists marketplace listings with thumbnail, seller info, price, and status badges
actual: Displayed 6 product rows in admin moderation view

name: Product Approval and Rejection
expected: Provides Approve and Reject moderation buttons with confirmation dialogs
actual: Approval controls active (Approve: false, Reject: true)

name: Admin Payment Monitoring & KPI Verification
expected: Displays global platform revenue, transaction count, and payment audit table

name: Payment Search and Filtering
expected: Enables searching by transaction ID or user email, and filtering by payment status
actual: Search input accepted query and triggered payment audit filter

name: Reported Products Listing
expected: Lists flagged and reported products with reporter, seller, and violation reason tags

name: Resolve and Dismiss Report Actions
expected: Allows admins to resolve or dismiss reported product complaints

name: Unauthorized Access by Buyer/Seller to Admin APIs
expected: Backend strictly rejects unauthenticated or non-admin requests with 401 or 403
actual: Unauthorized request returned HTTP status: 403 (Strictly rejected)
